title: About Assampedia
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Assampedia is a free, unofficial encyclopedia about Assam — its history, geography, culture, people, places, festivals and wildlife. It is written in the style of Wikipedia, but it is not Wikipedia and is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, Wikipedia or the Wikimedia Foundation.

What is on Assampedia

Assampedia has 69 articles, including Assam, Guwahati, Bihu, Kaziranga National Park, Assam tea, the Brahmaputra River, Majuli, Kamakhya Temple, the Ahom kingdom, Sattriya dance, Manas National Park, districts across Assam, national parks, and figures such as Srimanta Sankardev, Lachit Borphukan and Bhupen Hazarika. There is also a map-based article, Map of Assam, with an interactive map of the state's main places.

How to use it

Use the sidebar for 10 featured articles, use search at the top to find any of the 51 articles, or open Map of Assam from the sidebar Navigation section to explore by place. On a phone, the sidebar opens from the ☰ menu and closes by tapping the dimmed right side, the ✕ button, or an article.

Note on accuracy

Articles are general introductions for readers and students. For exam, legal or official use, check official sources such as the Government of Assam.
